integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof; finite numerical checker is supplementary; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only small-amplitude strictly decreasing radial logarithmic modulations of the standard Gaussian Fock symbol; the monotonicity restriction is sufficient, not known optimal. A general oscillatory pseudodifferential Weyl theorem could potentially subsume this explicit case.
title: Sharp logarithmic spectral cycles and measurable critical powers for radial Fock Toeplitz operators
